{{Quote|We were promised there would be no shadow cast from the new building onto the memorial.|translated=1|Woman discussing the Imperial building at a town hall|<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />}} 
A [[human]] '''woman''' with light skin and [[color|blue]] [[eye]]s lived the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> In [[19 BBY]], she lost her family in the [[Tarkin Massacre]] in which [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] landed his [[cruiser]] in [[Palmo Plaza]] on top of a group of peaceful demonstrators and [[death|killing]] five hundred who were blocking the landing,  unarmed civilians. Following the massacre a [[Monument to the Fallen|monument]] was installed in the plaza.<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere">{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}}</ref> When the [[Galactic Empire]] began construction of an armory in [[4 BBY]]<ref name="One Year Later">{{Andor|One Year Later}}</ref> under the guise of calling it an annex there was a promise that the building would never cast a shadow over the memorial. However as construction continued the women attended a town hall meeting in [[Palmo]] to express her concern that the Empire was breaking that promise. [[Lezine]], a fellow [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman]] interrupted her statement to express his belief that they knew that the Empire was building a fortress.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />

==Behind the scenes==
The woman was portrayed by [[Maroussia Frank]] and appeared in "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]", the fourth episode, of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
